steps.title: Validate Goal Tracking source records
steps.success_condition: The command passes and reports synchronized goals, evidence, execution, cadence, hierarchy, archive, cycle, risk, validation, view model, and static page records.
steps.next_action: Run before every scoped Goal Tracking commit.

steps.title: Validate generated Goal Tracking Center freshness
steps.success_condition: The generated view model and static page match the current structured source records.
steps.next_action: Regenerate with `npm run automation:goal-command-center-view` when the freshness check fails.

steps.title: Validate scoped secret and private-path exposure
steps.command: scoped sensitive-pattern scan over Goal Tracking files
steps.success_condition: No secret assignment, key block, private path, file URI, or editor URI appears in scoped Goal Tracking files.
steps.next_action: Keep scan output value-free and report only path/category if a finding appears.

steps.title: Validate bounded Goal Tracking update prompt
steps.success_condition: The prompt contract stays within the rendered character limit, references existing sources, defines eight ordered chunks, rejects padding, and exposes all proposal schema fields without secret-shaped values.
steps.next_action: Run before each canonical Goal Tracking update that uses the prompt package.

steps.title: Validate SEIS Enterprise Expansion V3 registry
steps.success_condition: The registry contains the exact eight-domain Enterprise Expansion V3 term sets, nine universal node fields, eight long-term horizons, seven forecast lanes, active Goal link, public-safe metadata, and explicit implementation non-claims.
steps.next_action: Run before each Enterprise Expansion V3 governance update and before decomposing any term into implementation work.

steps.title: Validate ten-year Enterprise Expansion stewardship contract
steps.success_condition: The registry contains ten ordered planned annual phases, session-based continuation state, required review cadences, eight stewardship metrics, explicit stop conditions, and no background execution claim.
steps.next_action: Run at every ten-year stewardship handoff and after any phase or continuation-state change.
